packageRules.description: Anything that parses untrusted input gets updated first (libwebp joins in M5).
Keep Kotlin, the Compose compiler plugin and the KGP-based detekt plugin together.
Dependency verification metadata must be regenerated with each update.
prBodyNotes: Regenerate `gradle/verification-metadata.xml`: `./gradlew --write-verification-metadata pgp,sha256 --export-keys check assembleRelease`, then review the diff.
